title: Using Gen AI Agents With GAE and VAE to Enhance Resilience of US Markets

claim.summary: The paper presents an LLM-query prototype and GAN/VAE backend for Treasury-rate scenario modeling; analyst judgments assess generated question relevance.

modules.name: LLM-generated scenario-model refinement queries
modules.scope_reason: The documented interface produces questions for interest-rate scenario models; automation of parameter updates is not demonstrated.
